enchantments.tooltip: Upgradeable - Tier 1: This item is a Tier 1 upgradable item.

children.tooltip: Weaken Construct: While wearing this item, your attacks cause constructs to lose 20% of their Fortification for the next 20 seconds. This effect does not stack with itself.
Sonic Lore +14: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

Cacophonic Guard: This weapon stores the power of a hundred blasts of sound within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this resonating power occasionally comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive sonic damage.
Resonance +96: Passive: +96 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Evocation Focus I: +1 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Anthem: When equipped by a character with Bard levels, this item begins to hum an inspiring tune. Your bard songs regenerate slowly over time.
